# Bundled browser libraries

- ipaddr.js 2.2.0: IPv4 parsing. Upstream: https://github.com/whitequark/ipaddr.js. License in `LICENSE`.
- Lucide 1.8.0: interface icons. Upstream: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide. License in `lucide-LICENSE`.

Runtime assets are checked in, so no dependency installation is needed to run or publish this lab.

PDF certificates use the bundled pdf-lib browser library (MIT license in `pdf-lib-LICENSE.md`). Certificate artwork is rendered locally and embedded into a landscape PDF; no assessment or learner data is sent to an external PDF service.
